name: Spider Climb
summary: Lets a creature climb walls and ceilings with its hands free.

m.text: a drop of bitumen and a spider

stats.effect: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a {ref:glossary/climb-speed} equal to its {ref:glossary/speed}.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2.
